tools.name: pinecone_list_indexes
tools.description: List the indexes in the project with dimension, metric, host, and readiness. Good first call to find an index name. Pinecone API: GET /indexes.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_index
tools.description: Get one index: dimension, metric, deployment, status, and the data-plane host. Pinecone API: GET /indexes/{index_name}.

tools.name: pinecone_list_collections
tools.description: List collections (static snapshots of indexes) with size, status, and vector count. Pinecone API: GET /collections.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_collection
tools.description: Get one collection: size, status, dimension, and vector count. Pinecone API: GET /collections/{collection_name}.

tools.name: pinecone_describe_index_stats
tools.description: Get vector counts per namespace and index fullness, optionally for vectors that match a metadata filter. Pinecone API: POST /describe_index_stats on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_list_namespaces
tools.description: List the namespaces of an index with their vector counts, one page at a time. Pinecone API: GET /namespaces on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_query_vectors
tools.description: Find the most similar vectors to a query vector, or to a stored vector id, with optional metadata filter. Returns ids, scores, and metadata. Pinecone API: POST /query on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_fetch_vectors
tools.description: Fetch stored vectors (values and metadata) by id. Pinecone API: GET /vectors/fetch on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_list_vector_ids
tools.description: List vector ids in a namespace, one page at a time, optionally by id prefix. Ids only, no values. Pinecone API: GET /vectors/list on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_upsert_vectors
tools.description: Insert vectors, or replace the values and metadata of vectors that already have the same id. Up to 100 vectors per call. Pinecone API: POST /vectors/upsert on the index host.

tools.name: pinecone_delete_vectors
tools.description: Delete vectors by id, by metadata filter, or all vectors in a namespace (delete_all). Deletion cannot be undone. Pinecone API: POST /vectors/delete on the index host.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pinecone_describe_index_stats · Public sink: pinecone_describe_index_stats, pinecone_query_vectors, pinecone_upsert_vectors, pinecone_delete_vectors · Destructive: pinecone_delete_vectors.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pinecone_describe_index_stats · Public sink: pinecone_describe_index_stats, pinecone_query_vectors, pinecone_upsert_vectors, pinecone_delete_vectors · Destructive: pinecone_delete_vectors

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
